description: This file manages ambient context for the Global Task Framework (GTF) in the Superset project, providing functions and context managers to access and set task execution context using contextvars.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Provides ambient access to the current TaskContext, raising RuntimeError if called outside a task execution context.

methods.name: use_context
methods.description: A context manager that sets the provided TaskContext as the current context during its scope, ensuring cleanup after execution.
